header.title: Manage {organizationName} capabilities.
header.body: Add what your organization provides, then add market context when it is useful.

assistance.title: Start in your own words
assistance.placeholder: For example: We inspect and repair commercial stormwater systems…
assistance.help: Review suggestions before adding one to your profile.
assistance.editHelp: Clarify the wording, then choose the capability that best fits.

claim.title: Review this capability
claim.marketRole: Market role · select at least one
claim.serviceGeography: Service area · select at least one
claim.boundaryBody: Saving adds this capability to your organization profile.

confirmed.title: Capabilities
confirmed.emptyBody: Describe what your organization provides or browse the capability catalog.

provisional.summary: None of the catalog terms fit
provisional.body: Suggest a new term instead of choosing an inaccurate capability. It becomes selectable after AMACS review.

industry.title: Industry context
industry.body: Add industry context for the markets your organization serves.
industry.industries: Industries served · comma or line separated
industry.selectorBody: Select a six-digit industry from {version} published by {source}.
industry.existingBody: Keep these values until you are ready to replace or remove them.
industry.boundaryBody: Industry context supports discovery; capability information is managed separately.

experience.title: Add past performance
experience.body: Add a project when it helps others understand your work.
experience.disclose: Show this value at the selected visibility
experience.boundaryBody: This project is information provided by your organization.
experience.emptyBody: Add a project when it helps others understand the organization’s work.

preferences.title: Teaming, referral, and resource preferences
preferences.body: Choose how your organization prefers to participate and be contacted.

notices.genericSaveError: Review the fields and try again.
notices.suggestionsReadyBody: Choose a suggestion to review before adding it to your profile.
notices.assistanceUnavailableBody: Browse or search the capability catalog instead.
notices.confirmedBody: Review the capability details, then save it to your organization.
notices.editedBody: Choose the capability that best matches the corrected description.
notices.nonAuthoritativeBody: Your profile is unchanged until you save a capability.
notices.dispositionErrorBody: Refresh and review the suggestion again.
notices.closedBody: Search the catalog or suggest a new term.
notices.claimSavedBody: This capability is now on your organization profile.
notices.industrySavedBody: Your industry context is now saved.
notices.industryConflictBody: Another update changed this profile. Review the latest information before saving again.
notices.experienceSavedBody: This project is now on your organization profile at the visibility you selected.
notices.preferencesSavedBody: Your organization preferences are now saved.
notices.provisionalSavedBody: The proposed term is awaiting AMACS review.
